'''Spelt''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|spelt flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|spelt beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] spelt for its ''beer''.
